pages.title: Finding Carmot
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 24 to 52. Veins target up to 4 blocks, with 5 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 5.

pages.title: Working Carmot
pages.text: Smelt Carmot Ore or Carmot Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 414 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 5.$(br)Mining efficiency: 4.9.$(br)Material damage bonus: 1.4.$(br)Enchantability: 7.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 5, leggings 4, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 1.0.$(br)Enchantability: 7.

pages.title: Tool: Autonomous
pages.text: Harvesting a block will mine surrounding blocks of the same type in a spherical range

pages.title: Armor: Power User
pages.text: You can consume and use items faster depending on how many armor pieces you wear; if you wear a full set you also get a Haste III buff

pages.title: Weapon: Abattoir
pages.text: Attacking a mob will also attack mobs of the same type in a radius around the initial strike
